title: I Am the Light of the World
description: This sermon emphasizes Jesus as the light of the world, highlighting the transition from death to life through belief in Him. It explores the significance of following Jesus, having Him as our light, and the connection between light and life. The message delves into the Pharisees' objections, Jesus' relationship with the Father, and the crucial choice between belief leading to salvation or unbelief resulting in death in sins.
